post.text: BREAKING: 🇮🇷🇺🇸 Iran strikes 5 US Air Force refueling planes at Prince Sultan air base in Saudi Arabia, WSJ reports. https://t.co/EDodUYYY81
post.author_description: We are an independent media company bringing you unparalleled coverage of all-things geopolitics & BRICS News in real-time. Not an official government account.

description.description: A formation of multiple gray U.S. Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker aircraft parked in a line on an asphalt tarmac at an airbase. The aircraft belong to the Air National Guard (ANG), with tail markings indicating units like the 185th Air Refueling Wing. Several ground power units are positioned in front of the planes, and large hangar buildings are visible in the background under an overcast sky.
